summary: This dataset contains preliminary data for the AWARE2.0 model, organized into two groups: stochastic and prospective. The stochastic group includes data used to generate uncertainty parametrizations for discharge-related input variables, Monte Carlo simulation results, and uncertainty distributions expressed as parametric functions. The prospective group includes ActAvail and CF data used to calculate model-specific climate-prospective and fully prospective ensemble results, as well as ensemble means and spatiotemporally aggregated CFs.
